page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (a catchword-like "Ruth.4" and "Ulsm" type references); page number at the head. Bottom: signature "B 4".

main_text.p: um refert.Nam fi brutorū animalium fœcun-ditas uni Deo afcribenda eft,fuumq; munus re-putari ipfam vult; ô igitur ingratos nos, fi pro nihilo ducamus,ubi tam gratiofo & amabili pa-rentum titulo nos ornat?Quātum, quæfo,in li-berorum formatione miraculum?mirè aluntur in utero matris, undiq; conclufi, extrahuntur, reguntur,adduntur angeli cuftodes:cujus argu-menti pleniorem explicationem videre eftPfal. mo 13y.quàquam hoc David ita tractat,ut inge-nuè fateatur fe longè imparem effe huic tantæ tamq; eximiæ gratiæ Dei celebrandæ.Sic alibi vocantur plantulæ in paradifo Domini,id eft ec-clefia,confitæ,quæ ceu palma florent tã hyeme quàm æftate,imò in omnem feculorum æterni-tatem,teftanteDavidePfal.92. Plantati in domo Je-hovæ,in atriis Dei noftri florebūt,adhuc fructificabunt in fenectute,pingues & virides erunt, &c. Sunt baculi feu fcipiones imbecillis fenectæ parentum,in quos tota domus inclinata recumbat. Videtisne præ-claram pietatis mercedem?Notatur etiā hic ob-fequentia liberorum,eorumq; ufus erga paren-tes,quib. ad manum funt velut viro potenti fa-gittæ,funt fuftentatio & protectio parentum:e-cōtra proles impia potius fubverfio quàm pro-tectio parentum,& fimilior jaculis in manu ad-verfarii, quàm in manu parentum conftitutis. Ifthæc omnia probe tenere reddet parentes ala-cres ad cupidè amplectendū eximium hoc Dei donum,idq; fui officii effe intelligent,ut à quo eos tanquam de manu in manum acceperunt.

page.notes: Right margin notes: "Ruth.4." beside the line "Ruth.4" in the margin; "Ulsm" printed in margin (doubtful, possibly a catchword/signal). Greek and Hebrew absent. Several Latin words with long s are transcribed as plain s; some marginal marks are doubtful.
